title: Beginning of an analytical approach
content: Hello friends. Over the next few months I am going to attempt to survey and catalogue common features and various dynamics within these experiences and these communities. If anyone with a data or research background would like to be a part, I wish to share publishing credit for the paper and proceeds from any content made of its communication. (Not going to plug my tiny channel yet before there is relevant content to be had). Please DM me if you’d like to conspire— I will accordingly be sending DMs to anyone whose post I wish to quote or otherwise use. Thanks! -OPwþ
